image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of several audio cassette tapes stacked on a surface. The primary subject is a Philips MCX 90 cassette in the foreground, featuring a transparent plastic shell with black internal components and white printed text. Behind it are other cassettes, including one with a paper label. The image has a vintage aesthetic with a blue color cast, vignetting, and a film border overlay containing frame numbers and 'RVP100' text.
